### Added
- **`tenants.organizations.enabled` also turns on agent-manager's tenant reconciler** (giantswarm/agent-platform#1044). With agent-manager on, its release gets `tenants.enabled: true` (it starts with `--multi-tenant`), the kagent namespace's default ModelConfig `default-model-config` with its key Secret (`kagent.providers.<default>.apiKeySecretRef`), the workers' network policy (`substrate-workers` on Cilium, `substrate-workers-ingress` on the kubernetes flavor, none with `networkPolicy.enabled` off) and 1 warm worker for each tenant that holds an agent as `tenants.workerPoolReplicas` (`agent-manager.tenants.workerPoolReplicas` overrides it). The render fails, naming the key, with an agent-manager range below 2.1.0, kagent off, agent-manager's OAuth or downstream OAuth off, an empty `kagent.fluxServiceAccountName`, a default provider without `apiKeySecretRef`, or `agent-manager.tenants.enabled` set against the switch. Off, agent-manager's values do not change. `make verify-tenant-reconciler`.
### Refactored
- **`make verify-flux-crds`, `verify-substrate-store`, `verify-wiring` and `verify-metric-labels` pass on macOS too.** Their recipes no longer need GNU `sed -i`, GNU `sed`'s `0,/re/` address, `grep -P` or an unpadded `wc -l`, so they run with the BSD tools of a Mac as on CI. They check the same things.
